description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Web Cryptography Working Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SubtleCrypto/deriveKey

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

'crypto.subtle.deriveKey' doens't return a usable object

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

since ''crypto.subtle' is supported in web workers. on a function call within a web worker it only returns a string '[object CryptoKey]' the very same method in a vanilla script returns the actual 'CryptoKey' object. what am i doing wrong?

What did you expect to see?

the actual 'CryptoKey' object.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

yeah, but the project isn't finished yet.

Do you have anything more you want to share?

function genkey(){ this.algo={name:'AES-GCM',length:256};this.iterations=4e5;this.hash='SHA-512'; this.name='PBKDF2';this.salt=headUp('FreedomToThePeople'); this.generate=async function(prime,that={}){ return new Promise(async(resolve)=>{ let d;for(d of Object.keys(that))this[d]=that[d];this.salt=prime.salt; key=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',prime.iv,{name:this.name},false,['deriveKey']); key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey(this,key,this.algo,false,['encrypt','decrypt']); return resolve({prime:prime,key:key}) }) } } why does this not work in a web worker?

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/SubtleCrypto/generateKey

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Parameters, 'extractable'

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

Throughout the page, references are made to 'the key'. This can be misleading because the generateKey function can create pairs of public and private keys, instead of a single key.

It is unclear in such cases, importantly, whether the extractable parameter affects the private key, the public key, or both. The CryptoKeyPair page doesn't clarify this, either.

In Deno 2.3.1, Safari 18.4 and Firefox 139.0b6, the public key appears to always be extractable.

What did you expect to see?

Ambiguous or incorrect references to 'the key' should be clarified to reflect the standard behavior more precisely.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response

MDN URL

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Supported Algorithm

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

This page is missing information about the algorithm we can use. For example, for the RSA-OAEP there is a limit in the number of bytes you can encrypt. I did not check for the others algorithm but theses limitation are missing in the doc. Just a warning that says "The algorithm can have some limitation such as the size of the data to encode. Check the RFC for more information" would be really helpfull since the error message are basically inexistent at this point in time.

What did you expect to see?

An array with what an algorithm can encode and the limitation
